summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the new 'Edit Rentals' capability (PUT /api/rentals/{id} + Edit button/modal in rentals.tsx). Backend pytest 34/35 passed. The single failure is the pre-existing SB-001 vs SB-2001 seed mismatch flagged in prior iterations and explicitly noted to ignore. All 7 new TestRentalEdit cases pass, covering: delta-based inventory rebalancing on qty increase/decrease (2->5 then 5->2), adding a new line + removing a line, returned_qty preservation and clamp-down when new qty < previously returned (also flipping status to 'returned'), status recomputation to 'active' with lat/lng preserved, 404 for unknown id, 401 without auth, 403 for crew role. created_at and id are preserved through PUT (verified against Mongo-truncated microsecond format). Frontend (390x844 mobile web preview, admin login via testIDs): the Rentals list card now renders 'Edit' outline button with testID `edit-rental-<id>` alongside Set location / Delivery PDF / Delete; tapping opens the New Rental modal titled 'Edit Rental' with every field pre-filled (customer_name=TEST_EditCust, phone=555-9999, email=edit@test.com, job_site=Edit Site, deposit=50, notes=orig, line items with correct qty, and prior 'No location set' hint retained); the save button reads 'Save Changes' in edit mode; the close X clears the draft and dismisses; the fresh New Rental modal correctly shows title 'New Rental' and button 'Save Rental'. Console warnings observed are the same two carried-over items (expo-notifications push token listener on web, props.pointerEvents deprecation from a 3rd-party dep) — non-blocking and pre-existing.

minor.issue: Pre-existing SB-001 vs SB-2001 seed-SKU mismatch; unrelated to this iteration and explicitly ignored per review request.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on web: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. Non-blocking; works on native builds. Reference: frontend push register effect.
Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from a 3rd-party RN dep; carried over from iteration_2/3/4.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Align TestEquipment.test_list_seeded with current seed SKUs (SB-2001 etc.) OR restore original SB-001 sample in server.py seed(). Pre-existing.
OPTIONAL: Chase the props.pointerEvents deprecation to its 3rd-party source dep in a future upgrade.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/rentals/{rental_id} in server.py:604 correctly computes per-equipment delta from outstanding (qty - returned_qty) OLD vs qty NEW, then applies a single $inc per equipment_id — this handles same-equipment lines and prevents double-counting.

returned_qty is preserved per equipment_id and clamped to min(old_returned, new_qty). Status recompute mirrors partial-return logic (returned / partially_returned / active). Edge case: if lines is empty, status defaults to 'active'.

id, created_at, and legacy due_date are preserved through PUT. created_at is stored in Mongo without 'Z' and with millisecond truncation; consumers comparing timestamps must parse via ISO — flagged in the test suite so future contributors don't hit it.
Auth: PUT uses require_role(Role.foreman); crew 403 and unauthenticated 401 confirmed. Unknown rental_id returns 404.

Frontend rentals.tsx: save() branches on draft.id (PUT vs POST) at line 139; Edit button emits testID `edit-rental-<id>` (line 278); modal title & save button labels flip on draft?.id (lines 299, 370). Confirmed the New Rental modal reuses the same component so all fields prefill automatically from the draft state.

Consideration: after a PUT that changes lines, the frontend re-fetches /rentals via load(); no equipment refresh is triggered on that screen (equipment.available shown elsewhere). Not a bug for this screen but callers of /equipment should refresh separately when appropriate.
